description: Lists the signed-in player's battles, newest first, up to 25 a page, narrowed and ordered as the battles page is. Each battle has its url, status, your result, ending, size, mission and one entry per seat (you, side, army, faction, detachments, score with its primary and secondary halves, rating change). A filtered page can come back short or empty while nextCursor is set; keep paging until nextCursor is null. Requires mcp:read.

before.description: nextCursor from the previous page; omit for the first page.

against.description: {in, out} lists of faction slugs the opposing side fielded. A battle must carry one of in (when given) and none of out.

againstDetachment.description: {in, out} lists of detachment names the opposing side fielded. A battle must carry one of in (when given) and none of out.

deployment.description: {in, out} lists of deployment ids. A battle must carry one of in (when given) and none of out.

detachment.description: {in, out} lists of detachment names your side fielded, exactly as shown, such as Awakened Dynasty. A battle must carry one of in (when given) and none of out.

ending.description: {in, out} lists of completed, finished-early, conceded, reported. A battle must carry one of in (when given) and none of out.

faction.description: {in, out} lists of faction slugs your side fielded, as list_factions gives them, such as necrons. A battle must carry one of in (when given) and none of out.

from.description: First UTC day to include, YYYY-MM-DD.

pack.description: {in, out} lists of mission pack ids, as list_reference gives them. A battle must carry one of in (when given) and none of out.

period.description: Only battles from the last 7d, 30d, 90d or 1y; overrides from and to.

player.description: {in, out} lists of player ids, from players[].id of a listed battle. A battle must carry one of in (when given) and none of out.

q.description: Text matched against player, army, faction, detachment and mission names.

result.description: {in, out} lists of won, lost, drawn, read from your seat; only finished battles have one. A battle must carry one of in (when given) and none of out.

size.description: {in, out} lists of battle sizes in points as text, such as 2000. A battle must carry one of in (when given) and none of out.

status.description: {in, out} lists of setup, playing, finished. A battle must carry one of in (when given) and none of out.

to.description: Last UTC day to include, YYYY-MM-DD.

type.description: {in, out} lists of practice (against an automated opponent), guest, team, manual (table keeps its own score), organised (counts for a group or tournament). A battle must carry one of in (when given) and none of out.

order.description: oldest for oldest first; omit for newest first.

name: list_my_battles
title: List my battles
